history.notes:
VLC can use Windows Super Resolution when supported.
TV enhancement controls now match each player's actual picture processing.
Playback prepares the selected enhancement level before the stream opens.

VLC now selects better HLS/DASH quality automatically.
VLC Auto keeps original audio; sound processing remains optional.
Streamer playback respects the 1080p display.

More live channels now have EPG data.
BEIN guide and fallback are more reliable.
Duplicate channel names now share one correctly matched guide entry.
Catalogue matching now uses provider names and source details more reliably.
Playlist updates keep catalogue mapping recoverable if interrupted.
Live TV fullscreen now clears the guide background and category filters.
Live channel previews recover more reliably after a connection error.

Updated optional Android VLC playback support.
Updated the Windows app runtime.
Tubi Catalogue settings are easier to navigate and read with the remote.
